title: 1-Cycle Pulse Detector
constraints: Detect a **single-cycle high pulse**: the last three samples of `din` were 0, 1, 0 (oldest first).
`pulse` is registered: it is 1 during the cycle right after the edge that sampled the final 0.
Wider pulses (0110, 01110, …) must not be detected. Synchronous reset clears the history (all samples 0). Must be synthesizable.
hints: Keep the last two samples in a 2-bit shift register.
At each edge: `pulse <= (hist == 2'b01) && !din`, where hist holds {older, newer} = {0, 1}.
Reset the history to 00. Then a first sample of 1 followed by 0 still counts as a pulse.
